mapper.sql: id, incident_no, incident_key, service, alert_name, severity, state, summary, first_seen, last_seen, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, resolved_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sre_incident WHERE incident_key = #{incidentKey} AND state IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'INVESTIGATING', 'MITIGATED') ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sre_incident WHERE state IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'INVESTIGATING', 'MITIGATED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_incident ( incident_no, incident_key, service, alert_name, severity, state, summary, first_seen, last_seen, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, resolved_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{incidentNo}, #{incidentKey}, #{service}, #{alertName}, #{severity}, #{state}, #{summary}, #{firstSeen}, #{lastSeen}, #{acknowledgedBy}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{resolvedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sre_incident SET state = #{state}, acknowledged_by = #{acknowledgedBy}, acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt}, last_seen = #{lastSeen}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND state NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')

UPDATE sre_incident SET state = #{state}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, last_seen = #{lastSeen}, acknowledged_by = #{acknowledgedBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND state NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
